stages.cue: They told me about the Sanctuary. About my First Breath, and the five pairs of hands waiting to hold me.
stages.description: A child's birth and welcome into the community. Cali's parents remember her First Breath at the Sanctuary.

sources.anchor: They spoke of my First Breath and taking me home from the Sanctuary
The moment of arrival is called "First Breath"

stages.cue: They told me about the Sanctuary. About my First Breath, and the five pairs of hands waiting to hold me.
stages.description: The place where children are born and welcomed by their waiting parents. Cali's parents brought her home from the Sanctuary.

sources.anchor: They spoke of my First Breath and taking me home from the Sanctuary
All Astraviin children are born at the Sanctuary

stages.cue: Lumen, the child of Aurora and Nyx, was still a young world when I was born.
stages.description: Cali's home: a young world, the child of Aurora and Nyx. Its community is still growing.

sources.anchor: Lumen, the child of Aurora and Nyx, was a world still in its infancy

stages.cue: Lumen was a living ship. I had grown up inside that life without needing to picture its whole shape.
stages.description: Cali's home: a young, living Astravus, the child of Aurora and Nyx. Its gardens, paths, and gathering places are part of the world its residents share.

sources.anchor: Lumen, the child of Aurora and Nyx, was a world still in its infancy
the living ship that had given us this remarkable gift

stages.cue: With Lyra's arrival, my parents' constellation had three children to raise together.
stages.description: A committed romantic partnership among adults. Cali's five parents form a constellation; the family they raise together also includes their children and animal companions.

sources.anchor: My parents were part of one such diverse and loving constellation, with five adults raising three children

stages.author_clarification: The author's September 4, 2026 clarification takes precedence over wiki passages that include the whole household in the term.

stages.cue: They lived aboard an Astravus, a great living ship traveling through the cosmos. Its passages were as familiar to them as these halls are to you.
stages.description: A great living ship that travels through the cosmos and is home to a community. In Sage's story, Aria, Bram, and Cora live aboard one.

sources.anchor: aboard a great Astravus traveling through the cosmos
They lived within the living ship

stages.cue: The Tree of Echoes. Dorian told us about it.
stages.description: An old, hollow tree from Dorian's stories. Cali and her siblings find it in a clearing along an unfamiliar path.

sources.anchor: This must be the Tree of Echoes
One clear afternoon, we followed a path we hadn't taken before.

stages.cue: It grew from a seed another Astravus gave. An ancient one. Then the tree came here when Lumen was founded.
stages.description: An ancient, hollow tree brought here when Lumen was founded. It grew from a seed given by an ancient Astravus, a reminder of the community's heritage.

sources.anchor: It was transplanted here when Lumen was founded. The tree was already ancient, grown from a seed gifted by an ancient Astravus.

stages.cue: In our world, where transcendence and joining with one's Astravus was the norm, and death among the Astraviin was nearly unheard of, Joren's loss was profoundly shocking and unbearably painful.
stages.description: The people who live within and share a close bond with an Astravus. Cali and her community are Astraviin.

sources.anchor: As Astraviin, we shared a deep and intimate connection with our home
death among the Astraviin was nearly unheard of
